cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your sister's bringing her future self to dinner. Reserve two chairs for her. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Use mine. I won't make either of her eat standing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put the extra chair beside hers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'tomorrow' on its place card. I need to know which one can tell me how tonight went.

mechanism: A manages dinner seating and gives up A chair to get B to make a real place for a future version of a guest.
confusable: Unlike merely discussing time travel, the requested extra chair and tomorrow place card change actual hosting choices.
comparison: Temporal guest identification differs from feeding and catching drips from a ceiling.
seedUse: D155-b sister future self, extra chair and tomorrow card; S02-b personal seating concession keeps B helping.
